card.fires_on: The word just before "interaction(s)", mostly "drug" in "Drug Interactions" cross-references and "formal drug interaction studies". Also a word like "will" before "interact".

modes.label: Other lead-ins to interact
modes.description: A word that leads into interact/interaction, such as "will" or a pharmacokinetic term.
